# 0028: The report page is built from a component workspace and shipped as one file

Status: accepted, 2026-08-23. Refines [0020](0020-captured-report-is-a-static-microsite.md),
[0021](0021-metric-names-carry-unit-and-provenance.md) and
[0024](0024-context-window-metrics-injected-messages-and-design-tokens.md); keeps
[0003](0003-runresult-is-a-stdlib-dataclass.md).

## Context

`assets/report.html` grew to 870 lines of hand-written HTML, CSS and vanilla
JavaScript in one file: a component library built from template strings, a hash
router, two chart axes, a record-card renderer and the theme plumbing, with Plotly
and highlight.js pulled from a CDN at view time. It works, and 0021's named ids and
glossary keep it legible, but every change is made without types, without a test
runner that can mount a component, without a formatter, and without any way to see
the page against real data short of re-running a sweep or a replay. Composing a
table by concatenating strings is how the `total_tokens` / `context %` columns came
to sit beside each other and read as one quantity.

The bar the report is held to is a polished single-page application, and the tools
that produce those are well known: a typed component model, a design-system
component library, a bundler, a unit-test runner that renders components, a linter
and a formatter. None of them may become a runtime dependency of the Python package
(0003), and the page must still be one static file that `report.py` copies beside
the captured JSON, fetches from there or is populated inline, and is themed by
`report.tokens.json` (0020, 0024).

## Decision

The page is authored in `report-ui/`, a bun workspace: Vite, React, TypeScript in
strict mode, Tailwind and shadcn/ui components, Vitest with Testing Library, ESLint
and Prettier. `bun run build` emits **one** self-contained `dist/index.html` with
every script, style and font inlined (`vite-plugin-singlefile`); nothing is fetched
from a CDN at view time any more. The built file is promoted into
`src/pytest_xharness_eval/assets/report.html` with `make ui-promote` and committed,
so the Python package ships a plain asset and keeps zero runtime dependencies;
bun is needed to change the page, never to use the plugin.

Three contracts from the first microsite are kept, so `report.py` does not change:
the `<!--XHARNESS_INLINE_DATA-->` marker at the top of `<head>`, the
`window.__XH_DATA__` inline payload as the alternative to fetching `index.json`,
`*.result.json`, `*.jsonl` and `report.tokens.json` from beside the page, and the
`#session/<id>[/turn/<n>]` hash routes. The element ids and names of 0021's glossary
are the component names: `SessionTable` is `<SessionTable>`, and a new panel gets
its id, its glossary row and its component in the same change.

Design tokens theme shadcn: `applyTokens` writes every token as an `--xh-*` custom
property at runtime, and `index.css` aliases shadcn's semantic variables
(`--background`, `--primary`, `--chart-1`, …) to them, so a project's
`xharness_report_design_tokens` file restyles every component without a rebuild.

Development is against real data: `make ui-dev CAPTURED=<skill>/evals/captured`
serves the captured directory under the Vite dev server, and
`make ui-smoke CAPTURED=…` builds the page, populates it through `report.inline_page`
(the same code path as `--xharness-report-inline`) and renders it headlessly in
jsdom, printing the rows it mounted. There are no fixture JSONs for the page to
drift from.

The move is panel by panel. This record lands the workspace, the contracts, the
theming, `ReportHeader`, `SweepOverview` with `SessionTable`, and `SessionView` with
`SessionMetaTable`. Still on the legacy template, and moved in later changes:
`TokenAccumulationChart`, the per-session charts (`ContextWindowChart`,
`TokenWaterfallChart`, `TurnTiersChart`, `OutputPerTurnChart`, `ChartAxisToggle`),
`SessionTurnTable` and `TurnRawRecords` with the record-card component library,
`SkillCoveragePanel`, `RecordKindsPanel`, `CostByTierPanel`, `ReconciliationPanel`
and `FinalMessagePanel`. Charts will use shadcn's chart components over Recharts,
replacing Plotly. Until parity, `assets/report.html` stays the legacy page and
`ui-promote` is not run.

## Consequences

A contributor changing the page needs bun; one changing the plugin does not. The
built page is a ~330 kB committed artifact that changes on every UI change, which is
the price of a dependency-free wheel. CI type-checks, lints, tests and builds the
workspace on every push now; once the page is promoted, the same job rebuilds it
and fails on a difference from the committed asset, so the two cannot drift. `src/components/ui/` is
shadcn's generated code and is excluded from lint and format. The root
`.gitignore`'s Python patterns (`lib/`, `dist/`) are carved out for
`report-ui/src/lib/`. While the move is in progress the two pages coexist; nothing a
user sees changes until promotion.

## Lens

Hold a user-facing page to the tooling a page of that quality is built with, and
let the build, not the runtime, carry the dependencies.
